steps.en: The list is routed to the OIC
steps.why_en: Only a one-case assignment field exists elsewhere.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada field penugasan satu kasus di fitur lain.

steps.en: The OIC reviews the list and can change it
steps.id: OIC meninjau daftar dan dapat mengubahnya
steps.why_en: The OIC review screen is for another decision, not this list.
steps.why_id: Layar review OIC untuk keputusan lain, bukan daftar ini.
